direction: Dawn, about 200 BC. A small homestead on the top of Llandough hill: thatched roundhouses with wattle-and-daub walls inside an earth bank, a raised granary on posts and a hurdle fold with a few small dark cattle. Smoke seeps up through the thatch and mist lifts off the reed marsh of the Ely far below. Caption: c. 200 BC, Llandough hill above the River Ely; spoken in modern Welsh, the nearest living language to theirs.
